answer: Delayed-VRF Shard Lottery (DVSL): agents commit fresh keys before a threshold-BLS crystal beacon publishes epoch randomness. A VRF maps each commitment into a Merkle trellis of shards; only VRF-selected leaves get active slots, and auditors from a rotating knoll challenge assigned leaves. Attackers cannot precompute favorable placements, so each Sybil needs an independent live key, unpredictable shard maintenance, and repeated challenge responses; most dud registrations yield no slot.
